name: interop/rtti
features: cross-TU Itanium RTTI with virtual diamond and multiple inheritance
upcast, downcast, crosscast, const cast, null cast and complete-object void cast
failed pointer and reference dynamic_cast with std::bad_cast handling
covariant-return adjustment through root, left and right virtual dispatch
secondary-base virtual deletion and exact final destruction invariants

name: interop/exceptions
features: cross-TU typed class exception catch through a nonzero-offset base
typed pointer catch with base adjustment and const qualification conversion
rethrow preserves original derived class and original derived pointer type
RAII cleanup of producer and consumer frames during both unwind paths
exception object and heap-thrown object lifetime completion

name: interop/ownership
features: nontrivial move-only aggregate return and by-value parameter ABI
std::string argument and aggregate member across GNU C++ ABI boundary
unique_ptr ownership transfer, stable pointee identity and destruction on both sides
adjusted data and nonvirtual/virtual function member pointers from both TUs
inline variable and function address identity across TUs
inline function-local static, variable template and template-local static ODR identity
